name: Fujiwara Rina
source:
The heir of the Fujiwara family, she is a quarter Northern European.
She is strong-willed and proud as she looks, but she also shows a sweet side to those she trusts.
Using her looks, she has achieved good results in numerous competitions as the captain of the cheerleading club, and has attracted the attention of students from other schools. She has a small crush on the protagonist.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc032/character/rina.html]official site[/url]]
